quest.title: When They Take Off Their Armor
quest.description: "Has anyone seen Captain Kaeya?" "Kaeya? you'll find him in the tavern. Hehe... You must be new here, no? Well, good luck!"

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well, well. This is a surprise. I didn't expect to see you two behind the counter today.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: In that case, I'd like a Death After Noon...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Leave it to Kaeya to make things difficult right from the start...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Come now, I just wanted to see how {F#she'd}{M#he'd} react. I admit I didn't expect to see you here today, Sister Rosaria.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: With so many demanding customers that frequent the tavern, I only thought I'd help the Traveler gain some experience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There he goes with that smooth talk again!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, I was only trying to be helpful! If anything, you should be thanking me. Now, how about we start with something simple like a Moonlit Alley, for instance.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, and make it a large, please.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I'll leave my drink up to you. Just make it a tea of some kind, and not too big.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it. Coming right up.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Please, take your time. Waiting in anticipation is half the fun.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it, Rosaria? You don't like the drink?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can make you another one...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: No, the drink you made me is fine. It's just that I rarely ever drink tea. The taste always reminds me of certain... things.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah, I presume you're referring to the church?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Yes. The church once held an event that I couldn't attend, but Sister Barbara still saved some tea and dessert for me...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: The dessert had already gone stale, so she whisked it away when I wasn't looking, but the tea tasted just like this drink you made me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Boy, you're in rare form today, Rosaria.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Sounds to me like Mondstadt's just gained another black tea lover.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Heh, I'd prefer something a little stiffer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about you, Kaeya? How's your drink?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That depends. If I point out a few flaws, will you make me another one?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I'm just kidding. I'd never subject you to such treatment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gosh, Kaeya sure is a tough nut to crack, you never know what he'll say next. How can you stand to drink with this guy, Rosaria?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Hmm? I don't really care what's going through his mind, as long as we only talk about drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Besides, Kaeya's only interested in people or things that intrigue him, whether that's you, the innkeeper here, or anybody else...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey! How could you divulge so much about your dear old drinking buddy, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: You think I'm saying too much? Heh, get over yourself, it's no big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm constantly surrounded by uptight folks day-to-day. I prefer the easygoing atmosphere in the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ooh, are we gossiping about people who take themselves too seriously, now?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I know someone who could easily place in the "Top Three Most Serious People in Mondstadt."

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: As to their level of seriousness... Well, let me put it this way, they probably wouldn't even flinch if I said that to their face.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are there really rankings for people like that?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Of course. Just off the top of my head, there's a running list for the most consistent drinkers, hardest workers, worst cooks, or even... biggest hoarders of dark secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds to Paimon like Mondstadters have way too much time on their hands!

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Are there really that many people who don't need to work?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aww, but what about Paimon? Is there a category that Paimon can be ranked as high as {F#her}{M#him}?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Why, of course. How about, "Best Bartenders"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's great, {NICKNAME}! Our names will be remembered together forever!

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Well, I must admit, the atmosphere you bring isn't half bad.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You can say that again. Just looking at these two brings a smile to my face.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Good bartenders create a nice atmosphere and get people in a good mood. You know, like a mascot... so I guess there's really no contest for the title of "Best Bartenders."

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Heh, nothing. Thanks for your hospitality.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Yeah, I should be going, too.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: By the way, that black tea tasted great. I'll try to make some for myself in the future... if I can manage to get up early enough in the morning, that is.

choices.text: I think I know who he's talking about...

talks.objective: Give the drinks to Keaya and Rosaria

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't look like the drink they ordered. Just give this one to Paimon and try making another.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Alright, this drink is looking good.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Done. Let's get started on the next drink.)
